name: 1 · New enquiry → AI triage → Sheets + Slack + draft reply

parameters.content:
## New enquiry → AI triage
A website form, Tally or Typeform posts to the webhook.

1. Clean up the payload and reject junk
2. Claude classifies it and drafts a reply (structured JSON)
3. Business rules override the model for complaints and refunds
4. Every real enquiry is logged to Google Sheets
5. Urgent ones ping Slack; all get a Gmail **draft** a person approves

Spam is acknowledged but never logged.
